replacement_evidence.title: Qoder 0.4.1 adds Skill evolution suggestions
replacement_evidence.evidence_summary: Qoder 0.4.1 can suggest creating or updating reusable Skills from experience after a conversation finishes; accepting a suggestion opens a separate conversation where the user confirms the plan before changes are applied.
replacement_evidence.distinction_from_prior_story: The September 25 AWS story covered evaluation of skill selection and instruction fidelity. This is a different product development about capturing repeated conversational experience into proposed reusable Skill creation or updates with explicit user confirmation.
